subject: label of RSW_FungalWeevil and its RM twin RM_Grellik (defNames unchanged)
why_rename: canon Grellik is a named nexu on Voss (SWTOR); Wookieepedia title 'Grellik' (pageid 527059), checked 2026-11-02. 'grellik' was agent-coined at ROT_FLORA_FAUNA_VERDICTS_1; the owner's note on that row (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/rot_regen_briefs.json) was only 'disgusting fungus bug hybrid, rename, 4 cells wide', so a new label is a delegated design call (delegation_policy.md §1: labels a player reads).
proposer: gpt_consult (fresh GPT session, not the maker), prompt D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\fungalweevil_label\propose_prompt.md with the 2563 dumped creature labels inlined

candidates.label: blummok
candidates.why: Two heavy syllables suggest a fat, sluggish beetle bulging with damp fungal growth.

candidates.label: plommak
candidates.why: Its rounded vowels and muffled middle suit a squat, unhurried crawler beneath fleshy fungal caps.

candidates.label: plobbum
candidates.why: Its soft, wet rhythm evokes a harmless but revolting little body waddling through fungus.

candidates.label: nuvvom
candidates.why: Its low, humming sound suits a slow fungal carrier huddled among its broodmates.

candidates.label: drebbum
candidates.why: Its sodden, lumpish sound fits an unpleasant beetle whose broods keep returning.

screen.method: exact label vs 26146 labels in defs.sqlite (capture 2026-11-02T17-59-18Z), 4-letter stem vs 2563 creature labels, Wookieepedia title search + 4-letter prefix search, GBIF species search, Wiktionary entry; sanity probes grellik/nexu (Wookieepedia hit), weevil (Wiktionary hit), curculio (GBIF hit)

judge: gpt_consult (second fresh GPT session; saw only the candidates, constraints and screen), prompt D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\fungalweevil_label\pick_prompt.md

verdicts.blummok: REDO: Its opening four letters match canon creature Blum-maggot, violating the precedent.
verdicts.plommak: REDO: Its opening four letters match canon Plom bloom; the precedent applies even though that name belongs to a plant.
verdicts.plobbum: KEEP: Soft, wet, and lumpish; suggests a fat, harmless, revolting crawler and stands apart from its biome-mates.
verdicts.nuvvom: KEEP: Readable and distinct, with a slow, muffled sound, though it conveys less bulk and disgust.
verdicts.drebbum: KEEP: Sodden and heavy-sounding, but its sharper opening feels less soft and sluggish than plobbum.

why_pick: Plobbum best evokes a swollen, damp little crawler without sounding dangerous. It passes the supplied screens, reads easily, and has a distinct sound among the Rot’s existing names.
